description: This file defines the ScopeEntity class within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 API module. It implements the ScopeEntityInterface and uses traits from the League OAuth2 server library to model OAuth2 scope entities, with a focus on JSON serialization of its identifier.

classes.name: ScopeEntity
classes.description: Represents an OAuth2 scope entity with serialization capabilities, implementing the ScopeEntityInterface and using traits for entity management.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Returns the scope identifier for JSON serialization.
